title: Field group
summary: A form drawn from a list of field specs: each entry becomes a pk-field with the right control (pk-input of every scalar type, pk-textarea, pk-select, pk-checkbox, pk-switch, pk-range, pk-combobox). Set fields (label, kind, hint, required, constraints, options, when) and values ({ key: value }); a committed change updates values and raises pk-change. A field with when (data: { field, equals | in | not }) or a visible(spec, values) callback property is not rendered at all while it is hidden, so a hidden required field can never block a submit; its value stays in values. The controls live in this element's shadow tree.

props.name: fields
props.description: The field specs, in order: { key, label, kind?, hint?, help?, required?, readonly?, disabled?, hideLabel?, span?, placeholder?, min?, max?, step?, minlength?, maxlength?, pattern?, rows?, options?: [{ value, label }], free?, when?, msg? }. kind is text (default), number, email, password, date, time, url, tel, textarea, select, checkbox, switch, range or combobox. hint is the line under the field, help a tooltip beside the label, span makes the field fill the row, msg is { constraint: text } for the form's validation messages.

props.name: values
props.description: The current values, { key: value }: a string, a boolean (checkbox, switch) or a number (range). The element keeps its own copy and replaces this property when the user commits a change (it never edits the object you gave it); pk-change carries the same values.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name of the group. See prefix.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Submit each field as name.key instead of key (a form with two groups that use the same keys).

props.name: columns
props.description: How many columns the fields flow into; a field with span fills the row.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every control; also set by a disabled fieldset.

events.name: pk-change
events.description: The user committed a change to one field: its key and value, and a fresh copy of every value. Fields whose when depends on it have already been shown or hidden.

parts.name: group
parts.description: The grid that holds the fields.

a11y: The host is role=group with the label as its name. Each field is a pk-field: a visible label, the hint under it and the error in its own region; the label, description and invalid state reach the control as properties, so nothing depends on an id crossing a shadow root. A field whose label is hidden (hideLabel) keeps it as the control's aria-label. A hidden field is removed from the tree, not just visually hidden.
